questions.query: How do I reset my API key?
questions.groundTruth: Navigate to Settings > API Keys > Regenerate. Your old key will be invalidated immediately.

questions.query: What's the rate limit for the free plan?
questions.groundTruth: 100 requests per minute for free plan, 1000 for pro, unlimited for enterprise

questions.query: How do I set up webhook notifications?
questions.groundTruth: Go to Settings > Webhooks > Add Endpoint. Enter your URL and select events to subscribe to.
API key, OAuth 2.0, and JWT tokens. Enterprise plans also support SAML SSO.

questions.query: How do I export my data?
questions.groundTruth: Use the Export feature in Settings > Data > Export. Supports JSON, CSV, and XML formats.

questions.query: What's the difference between pro and enterprise plans?
questions.groundTruth: Enterprise includes SSO, dedicated support, custom SLAs, and higher rate limits. Pro has standard features with priority support.

questions.query: How do I invite team members?
questions.groundTruth: Go to Team Settings > Members > Invite. Enter email addresses and select roles (admin, member, viewer).

questions.query: What file formats are supported for import?
questions.groundTruth: JSON, CSV, XML, and Excel (.xlsx). Maximum file size is 100MB for pro, 1GB for enterprise.
